question: Devendra Jhajharia is associated to which of the following games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Javelin throw**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Devendra Jhajharia is a prominent Indian Paralympic javelin thrower.
 
• He is the first Indian Paralympian to win two gold medals at the Paralympics, achieving this feat in 2004 (Athens) and 2016 (Rio).
 
• Devendra holds the world record in the F46 javelin throw event with a throw of 63.97 meters, which he set during the 2016 Rio Paralympics.
 
• He has been honored with several awards, including the Padma Shri in 2012 and the Padma Bhushan in 2022, recognizing his contributions to sports in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Paralympic Games**

 
 
• The Paralympic Games are a major international multi-sport event involving athletes with a range of disabilities, including impaired muscle power, limb deficiency, and visual impairment.
 
• The Paralympics are held immediately following the Olympic Games, using the same venues and facilities.
 
• The International Paralympic Committee (IPC) is the global governing body of the Paralympic Movement.
 
• The first official Paralympic Games were held in Rome in 1960.
 
 
 
• **F46 Category**
 
 
• This category is for athletes with upper limb deficiencies, including amputations and similar impairments.
 
• Javelin throwers in this category compete with certain modifications to accommodate their impairments.
 
• The classification system ensures fair competition among athletes with different types of disabilities.
 
 
 
• **Indian Paralympic Achievements**
 
 
• India has been participating in the Paralympic Games since 1968.
 
• Indian Paralympians have won medals in various sports, including athletics, swimming, and powerlifting.
 
• The country has seen a steady increase in the number of athletes qualifying for the Games and winning medals.
